question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**has**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The tense of the given passage is "present tense."**
 
• **Also, the verb in blank 3 should agree with the singular subject i.e. "everything."**
 
 
• 'Everything' is an indefinite pronoun that refers to all things as a singular collective unit. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'Has' is the correct form of the verb in the present tense for third-person singular subjects.
 
 
• ​Example: "He has a car."
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.​
